'''Tracer''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was put on a courier mission for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] with [[Deflector]] a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]]. They were shot down over [[Trivar II/Legends|Trivar II]], with Deflector becoming critically wounded, and died in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] custody in the city of [[Glare Peak]]. Tracer was then [[Rescue at Glare Peak|rescued]] by Rebel agents.
